name: MonarchStackedBarChart
title: StackedBarChart
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.Canvas through MonarchBarChart (stacked layout), inside MonarchChartFrame with MonarchChartLegend and MonarchChartTable
summary: Stacked bars showing how each category's total splits into parts, as values or as shares of 100%, vertical or horizontal, with totals, inspection, legend toggles, drill-in and the data as a table.
whenToUse: To show how a few parts make up each category's total, or, with the 100% offset, how the mix of parts changes from category to category.
whenNotToUse: To compare single values across categories use MonarchBarChart. For the parts of one whole use MonarchDonutChart or MonarchStackedProportionBar.
api: @Composable fun MonarchStackedBarChart(title: String, categories: List<String>, series: List<MonarchBarChartSeries>, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, description: String? = null, categoryTitle: String? = null, summary: String? = null, orientation: MonarchBarChartOrientation = MonarchBarChartOrientation.Vertical, layout: MonarchBarChartLayout = MonarchBarChartLayout.Stacked, offset: MonarchStackedBarChartOffset = MonarchStackedBarChartOffset.Normal, status: MonarchChartFrameStatus = MonarchChartFrameStatus.Ready, hiddenSeries: Set<String>? = null, onHiddenSeriesChange: ((Set<String>) -> Unit)? = null, highlightedIndex: Int? = null, referenceLines: List<MonarchBarChartReferenceLine> = emptyList(), valueRange: ClosedFloatingPointRange<Double>? = null, showValueLabels: Boolean = false, legendToggle: Boolean = true, tableToggle: Boolean = true, emptyMessage: String? = null, footer: String? = null, height: Dp? = null, labels: MonarchStackedBarChartLabels = MonarchStackedBarChartLabels(), formatValue: ((Double) -> String)? = null, onRetry: (() -> Unit)? = null, onSelect: ((Int) -> Unit)? = null)
class MonarchStackedBarChartLabels(bar: MonarchBarChartLabels = MonarchBarChartLabels(), shareSeries: String? = null)
class MonarchBarChartSeries(key: String, label: String, values: List<Double?>, color: MonarchChartColor? = null)
class MonarchBarChartReferenceLine(value: Double, label: String? = null)

options.name: title
options.description: The chart's name: the frame heading and the plot's spoken name.

options.name: categories
options.description: The categories in display order, already formatted by the app.

options.name: series
options.description: The parts, each with a key, a label, one value per category and an optional color slot. The first series sits on the baseline.

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the frame.

options.name: description
options.description: One line under the title.

options.name: categoryTitle
options.description: The heading of the category column of the table.

options.name: summary
options.description: Replaces the generated spoken summary.

options.name: orientation
options.description: Vertical columns or Horizontal bars.

options.name: layout
options.description: Stacked (one bar of parts per category) or Grouped (the parts side by side).

options.name: offset
options.description: Normal stacks the values; Expand stacks each category's shares so every bar is 100% long. Only applies when stacked.

options.name: status
options.description: Ready, Loading, Empty or Error. Ready with no categories or no series shows Empty.

options.name: hiddenSeries
options.description: The keys of hidden series. null lets the chart keep its own set (rememberSaveable), changed by the legend.

options.name: onHiddenSeriesChange
options.description: Called with the new hidden set when the legend changes it, in both modes.

options.name: highlightedIndex
options.description: A category to emphasise; the bars of the others take the disabled text color and TalkBack reads "Highlighted" on it.

options.name: referenceLines
options.description: Dashed lines at a value. Not drawn with the 100% offset.

options.name: valueRange
options.description: Fixes the value axis. With the 100% offset the axis is always 0.0..1.0 (0% to 100%).

options.name: showValueLabels
options.description: Writes each stack's total at its end (each bar's value when grouped). With the 100% offset the total is 100%.

options.name: legendToggle
options.description: Whether legend entries show and hide their series. The legend appears with two or more series.

options.name: tableToggle
options.description: Whether "View as table" is offered.

options.name: emptyMessage
options.description: The message of the empty state.

options.name: footer
options.description: Notes under the chart.

options.name: height
options.description: The plot height: 240dp for columns; 32dp per category plus one, at least 120dp, for bars.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the built-in strings: the bar chart's (frame, category, total, no data, details, clear, highlighted) and the share summary sentence.

options.name: formatValue
options.description: Writes values with the normal offset. With the 100% offset values are percentages in the current locale with at most one decimal, and this is ignored.

options.name: onRetry
options.description: Shows Try again in the error status.

options.name: onSelect
options.description: Drill-in: called with the category index (an index into the app's categories, also with the 100% offset) from Details in the inspection row or from the category's TalkBack action.

states.name: ready
states.description: The stacked plot, the legend (two or more series) and "View as table".

states.name: 100% offset
states.description: Every bar is 100% long; the value axis, value labels, inspection row, TalkBack, table and summary show percentages. Reference lines are not drawn.

states.name: inspecting
states.description: After a tap or a drag along columns: the category's band is shaded and a row under the plot reads every part and the stack's total, announced politely, with Details (when onSelect is set) and Clear.

states.name: highlighted
states.description: With highlightedIndex, the other categories' bars take the disabled text color.

states.name: series hidden
states.description: The part leaves the bars and the others keep their colors. With the 100% offset the others keep their shares, so the bar ends short of 100%. The table still lists it.

states.name: grouped
states.description: With layout Grouped the parts stand side by side and the offset is ignored.

states.name: loading
states.description: The frame's skeleton of the plot's height, read as "Loading chart".

states.name: empty
states.description: MonarchEmptyState with "No data yet" and the empty message.

states.name: error
states.description: The frame's error, with Try again when onRetry is set.

appearance: As MonarchBarChart: parts take the theme's data colors 1 to 5 in series order, then the subtle text color, with the far end of each stack rounded. Gridlines use the subtle border color, the zero line the strong border color and labels the muted text color. Every color is a theme role, so light, dark and both high-contrast themes are covered.
platformNotes: The web's StackedBarChart is its BarChart with stacking on and the 100% offset; on Android it is the same composition over MonarchBarChart, drawn with a Compose Canvas (iOS uses Swift Charts). Parts touch, as on iOS: MonarchBarChart has no hairline between stacked parts (the web separates them with the surface color). With the 100% offset the web formats axis ticks with no decimals and other values with one; Android uses one percent formatter with at most one decimal for both, as iOS does. Inspection is a tap or drag with a row under the plot, not a hover tooltip; there is no keyboard arrow navigation and no controlled activeIndex. iOS's hiddenSeries Binding becomes hiddenSeries with onHiddenSeriesChange; iOS's valueTitle is not offered because MonarchBarChart has no value axis for TalkBack to name.
accessibility: The plot is one element with the image role, named by the title, whose state description is the generated summary or the summary parameter: with values, MonarchBarChart's summary (categories, each shown series' total and highest category, reference lines); with the 100% offset, the categories, then each shown series' average share and largest share.
After it, one element per category in category order, read as the category, each shown part's value or share and the stack's total.
With onSelect, each category element has a TalkBack custom action named "Details, <category>" that calls onSelect with the category index.
The legend is MonarchChartLegend: each entry is a filter chip with the state "Shown" or "Hidden"; the last shown series cannot be hidden.
"View as table" shows every value or share as text, with a Total column when stacked.
Parts are told apart by the legend's names, the inspection row, TalkBack and the table, not by color alone.
edgeCases: With the 100% offset, negative values count as zero and a category whose positive total is zero has zero shares everywhere.
Shares are computed over every series, hidden ones included, so hiding a part leaves a gap instead of rescaling the others.
Gaps (null) and values that are not finite draw nothing and are read "No value" and shown "—" in the table.
With the normal offset, negative parts stack down from zero apart from the positive parts.
More than five series: the sixth and later take the neutral color.
TalkBack navigation and the touch gestures were checked with Robolectric semantics tests, not on a device with TalkBack; the share logic and summary are unit-tested.

examples.title: Stacked with totals
examples.template:
CompositionLocalProvider(LocalConfiguration provides locale) {
    MonarchStackedBarChart(
        title = {{title}},
        categories = listOf({{categories.0}}, {{categories.1}}, {{categories.2}}, {{categories.3}}, {{categories.4}}, {{categories.5}}),
        series = listOf(
            MonarchBarChartSeries({{series.0.key}}, {{series.0.label}}, listOf({{series.0.values.0|double}}, {{series.0.values.1|double}}, {{series.0.values.2|double}}, {{series.0.values.3|double}}, {{series.0.values.4|double}}, {{series.0.values.5|double}})),
            MonarchBarChartSeries({{series.1.key}}, {{series.1.label}}, listOf({{series.1.values.0|double}}, {{series.1.values.1|double}}, {{series.1.values.2|double}}, {{series.1.values.3|double}}, {{series.1.values.4|double}}, {{series.1.values.5|double}})),
            MonarchBarChartSeries({{series.2.key}}, {{series.2.label}}, listOf({{series.2.values.0|double}}, {{series.2.values.1|double}}, {{series.2.values.2|double}}, {{series.2.values.3|double}}, {{series.2.values.4|double}}, {{series.2.values.5|double}})),
        ),
        description = {{description}},
        categoryTitle = {{categoryLabel}},
        showValueLabels = true,
        valueRange = 0.0..300.0,
        height = 320.dp,
    )
}
examples.code:
CompositionLocalProvider(LocalConfiguration provides locale) {
    MonarchStackedBarChart(
        title = "Tickets by status",
        categories = listOf("Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun"),
        series = listOf(
            MonarchBarChartSeries("resolved", "Resolved", listOf(120.0, 132.0, 101.0, 134.0, 190.0, 230.0)),
            MonarchBarChartSeries("pending", "Pending", listOf(22.0, 18.0, 30.0, 25.0, 19.0, 21.0)),
            MonarchBarChartSeries("escalated", "Escalated", listOf(8.0, 6.0, 12.0, 9.0, 7.0, 5.0)),
        ),
        description = "First half of the year",
        categoryTitle = "Month",
        showValueLabels = true,
        valueRange = 0.0..300.0,
        height = 320.dp,
    )
}

examples.title: Shares of 100%, horizontal, with drill-in
examples.setup:
var opened by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
val teams = listOf("Support", "Sales", "Engineering")
examples.code:
MonarchStackedBarChart(
    title = "Ticket mix by team",
    categories = teams,
    series = listOf(
        MonarchBarChartSeries("open", "Open", listOf(42.0, 18.0, 27.0)),
        MonarchBarChartSeries("closed", "Closed", listOf(120.0, 64.0, 88.0)),
    ),
    categoryTitle = "Team",
    orientation = MonarchBarChartOrientation.Horizontal,
    offset = MonarchStackedBarChartOffset.Expand,
    footer = opened?.let { "Opened $it" },
    onSelect = { opened = teams[it] },
)
